Classic Teen Patti on Stars777 (The Base Game)

Three cards each. Highest hand wins. Ranking order stays standard:

  • Trail (three of a kind)
  • Pure Sequence (straight flush)
  • Sequence (straight)
  • Colour (flush)
  • Pair
  • High Card

Blind and seen play, chaal, side show, and show work as usual. This is the foundation every other variation builds on.

Muflis (Lowball) – When Low Becomes High

Muflis is one of the most popular Stars777 Teen Patti Variations. Everything about dealing and betting stays the same, but the hand rankings reverse completely. The lowest hand wins.

A high-card hand (especially something low and mixed like 2-4-7 of different suits) becomes strong. A trail of Aces turns into the weakest possible holding. Players who usually fold weak cards suddenly stay in longer. It’s perfect for nights when the cards feel unkind in the classic game. Strategy shifts: you start hoping for “nothing” instead of chasing sequences.

AK47 – Wild Cards Everywhere

Named after the famous rifle, AK47 makes A, K, 4 and 7 of every suit wild. That’s 16 jokers in a 52-card deck. Strong hands appear far more often. A single wild can turn an average holding into a trail or pure sequence.

On Stars777 this variation feels fast and aggressive. Expect bigger pots because almost everyone has a chance at something solid. The key skill becomes reading how many wilds opponents might be holding and deciding when a “made” hand is actually strong enough.

Joker Variation

After the deal, one card is turned face-up. All remaining cards of that rank become wild for the hand. Only three wilds are usually available (the other three of that rank). It keeps the game closer to classic Teen Patti than AK47 but still adds surprise. A late-appearing joker can completely change the value of your three cards.

Best of Four / Four-Card Teen Patti

Each player receives four cards and must form the best three-card hand. You get one extra option and slightly more control. On platforms like Stars777 this mode rewards careful selection — sometimes the card you discard is the difference between a pair and a sequence.

999 and Closest-to-555 Style Games

These move away from traditional ranking. Numbered cards keep their face value, face cards count as zero (or low), and the goal is to get as close as possible to 999 (or 555). Three 9s is the dream in 999. It feels almost like a different game and appeals to players who enjoy number-based decisions rather than pure poker-style ranking.

Other Modes You’ll Often See

  • 4x Boot – Starting stake is four times higher. Same rules, higher pressure from the first bet.
  • High-Low / Hi-Lo – Sometimes the lowest and highest cards in a player’s hand act as wilds for that player only.
  • Sudden Death or draw-style twists – Less common online but fun when available.

Stars777 rotates or offers several of these so the lobby never feels stale.

Tips for Playing Stars777 Teen Patti Variations in India

  1. Start with Muflis or Joker if you’re new to variations — they keep the core feel while changing just enough.
  2. In AK47, don’t overvalue ordinary pairs. Trails and pure sequences show up often.
  3. Manage bankroll carefully on higher-boot tables. Indian players know the temptation of “just one more” after a bad Muflis run.
  4. Use UPI for quick top-ups and withdrawals. Most Stars777-style apps process local payments smoothly.
  5. Play only on official or trusted sources. Availability varies by state — always check local rules.
